correctness.rationale: For the directed n-cycle plus n−1->1 shortcut, Boolean path propagation gives F^n>=I OR R: a base length-(n+1) tour can be shortened by a shortcut to advance one position in n steps. Iterating fills any zero gap L by time nL. Counting shortcuts in an nk-step walk (successive shortcuts need >=n−1 edges) shows T>n(L−2) when L>=2. Frobenius semigroup H=<n,n−1> proves unique maximizer e0 with T=(n−1)^2+1 and singleton times t_*-i. The largest zero-run in a uniform n-bit word is (1+o_P(1))log2 n by union bound and disjoint-block lower estimates; tail sums give expectation, and 2n error transfers to T. Independently enumerated all configurations 3<=n<=11 and confirmed uniqueness/bounds, but infinite family is proved analytically.
